description: Configuration class for FineractFeignClient; sets up HTTP clients, encoders, interceptors, and configurations for the Fineract API client using Feign.

classes.name: FineractFeignClientConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up Feign clients with various HTTP backends and SSL options.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a Feign client for the specified API type with configured encoders, decoders, interceptors, and HTTP client.

methods.name: getOrCreateHttpClient
methods.description: Returns the cached HTTP client or creates a new one if not initialized.

methods.name: createHttpClient
methods.description: Creates an HTTP client based on the specified client type (Apache or OkHTTP).

methods.name: createApacheHttpClient
methods.description: Configures and returns an Apache HTTP client with optional SSL trust-all.

methods.name: createOkHttpClient
methods.description: Configures and returns an OkHttp client with optional SSL trust-all.

methods.name: createTrustAllManager
methods.description: Creates an X509TrustManager that trusts all certificates.

methods.name: createTrustAllSslContext
methods.description: Creates an SSLContext that trusts all certificates.

inner_classes.name: Builder
inner_classes.description: Builder class for configuring and instantiating FineractFeignClientConfig instances.

methods.name: baseUrl
methods.description: Sets the base URL for the API.

methods.name: credentials
methods.description: Sets the username and password for basic auth.

methods.name: tenantId
methods.description: Sets the tenant ID.

methods.name: connectTimeout
methods.description: Sets the connection timeout.

methods.name: readTimeout
methods.description: Sets the read timeout.

methods.name: connectionTimeToLive
methods.description: Sets the connection lifetime.

methods.name: debugEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug logging.

methods.name: disableSslVerification
methods.description: Disables SSL certificate verification.

methods.name: maxConnTotal
methods.description: Sets the maximum total connections.

methods.name: maxConnPerRoute
methods.description: Sets the maximum connections per route.

methods.name: idleConnectionEvictionTime
methods.description: Sets idle connection eviction time.

methods.name: httpClientType
methods.description: Specifies the HTTP client type (APACHE or OKHTTP).

methods.name: build
methods.description: Validates parameters and builds a FineractFeignClientConfig instance.
